chats.name: Chat directory

suche.description: Filter chat names by this text; blank shows all allowed targets.

dienst.description: Optional messenger ID such as telegram; blank shows all services.

dienstraum_senden.name: Send to service room
dienstraum_senden.description: Send a message as the service room’s own sender; with a name the room is added first if needed.

entry_id.name: Instance
entry_id.description: Select the Buschfunk instance; if omitted exactly one must be configured.

kennung.name: Room ID
kennung.description: Stable ID of the service room: a–z, 0–9, - and _, up to 32 characters, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

name.name: Room name
name.description: Optional, 1 to 64 characters; when set the room is added or renamed before sending.

titel.name: Title
titel.description: Optional single line up to 120 characters, shown in bold above the text.

text.name: Message text
text.description: Text up to 4000 characters; no default.

wichtig.name: Important
wichtig.description: Mention your own account so the message also rings when the room is set to mentions only; default off.

bild.name: Picture file
bild.description: Allowed local HA file path; PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 1 MiB; becomes room and sender picture.

bild_entitaet.name: Picture entity
bild_entitaet.description: Alternatively an image or camera entity; its current picture is used, at most 1 MiB.

vorgang.name: Operation ID
vorgang.description: Optional UUID for safe retries; leaving it empty generates a new ID.

dienstraum_sicherstellen.name: Add or update service room
dienstraum_sicherstellen.description: Add the service room or update its name and picture; unchanged calls do nothing.
